findings.evidence: The seven new Listening entries are active configuration values, but the file comment explicitly labels each as a temporary, unsourced, non-production placeholder.
findings.why_it_matters: Deploying these values as official exam timing could give candidates incorrect prep/response windows even though snapshot pinning succeeds.
findings.required_action: Replace and independently verify all seven values, including section/timer semantics, before production release; this is the explicit release gate for this phase.

receipt_note: The plan/report lives in pte-doc while reviewed config/test files live in pte-api, a separate git repository under the pte-org parent. receipt.py requires one repository containing the report and every reviewed file, so no cryptographic receipt is issued.
